decisions.name: constrained canonical SVG IR
decisions.rationale: Adopt a thesis-owned, closed scientific SVG contract; preserve manifest-led scientific provenance and avoid browser-SVG permissiveness.

decisions.name: rendering-neutral semantic SVG markers
decisions.rationale: Use a small allowlist of thesis object IDs and non-visible semantic roles; do not duplicate Ledger provenance or make rendering depend on metadata.

decisions.name: static SVG quality checker
decisions.rationale: The fail-closed checker pattern is directly aligned with FigureCritic, but the thesis implementation needs its own research-semantic rules.

decisions.name: SVG-to-DrawingML compiler
decisions.rationale: First establish capability tests and native acceptance; if adopted, it must be an internal adapter beneath the sole assembler, never a second exporter.

decisions.name: PowerPoint/SVG capability matrix
decisions.rationale: A thesis-owned registry prevents silent vector/raster degradation and declares native-exact, normalized, fallback, and unsupported states.

decisions.name: native shape mapping
decisions.rationale: Useful implementation reference; require thesis test vectors before choosing reuse versus reimplementation.

decisions.name: Master/Layout metadata
decisions.rationale: Keep CP2/CP3 sanitized descriptors; only borrow explicit topology and reconstruction-manifest ideas.

decisions.name: Brand/Style/Layout/Deck taxonomy
decisions.rationale: Current split is already materially equivalent; rename/migrate only if a resolved contract collision emerges.

decisions.name: live SVG editor
decisions.rationale: Selection, nudge, overlap picking, history and annotation are useful review concepts; canonical edits must still become ReviewAction-led source revisions.

decisions.name: visual-review orchestration
decisions.rationale: Preserve separate static, render-derived, and human/image-capable review evidence.

decisions.name: artifact ownership model
decisions.rationale: Clarify canonical authored SVG, derived preview, approved output, compiled PPTX object, render, and QA report ownership.

decisions.name: native PPTX round trip
decisions.rationale: Incremental edits are valuable only after the new-deck pipeline has native acceptance; preserve immutable historical state first.

decisions.name: generated-deck orchestration
decisions.rationale: Generic orchestration cannot replace the Ledger, stage cursors, or Hypothesis Layer historical projection.

decisions.name: generic strategist/narrative planning
decisions.rationale: The thesis scientific method and recoverable failed-history requirements are higher authority.

decisions.name: React slide authoring
decisions.rationale: HTML/React pages are not the final scientific source nor the approved PPTX backend.

decisions.name: 1920x1080 browser canvas
decisions.rationale: Useful preview convention only; PowerPoint dimensions and calibrated shell remain authoritative.

decisions.name: current-slide context
decisions.rationale: A versioned, manifest-bound context makes deictic professor corrections reliable without changing scientific truth.

decisions.name: current-element selection
decisions.rationale: Adopt bounding-box/object-ID selection semantics, not React fiber or DOM as canonical figure identity.

decisions.name: comment-to-agent edit loop
decisions.rationale: Use immutable ReviewAction records bound to SVG object and manifest revision; do not embed JSX markers into canonical SVG.

decisions.name: live design tokens
decisions.rationale: Allow temporary preview overrides only through approval and calibration-update events, never direct mutation of professor evidence.

decisions.name: hot-reload preview
decisions.rationale: Helpful UX but not a prerequisite for deterministic figure contracts.

decisions.name: create-slide planning workflow
decisions.rationale: Its presentation-first one-idea convention conflicts with justified professor high-information-density research pages.

decisions.name: workflow/technical/context Skill decomposition
decisions.our_component: 17 Figure Skills plus technical reference Skills
decisions.rationale: Add narrow technical-reference/context Skills later rather than duplicating SVG/PPTX mechanics across specialist Skills.

decisions.name: HTML/PDF export
decisions.rationale: HTML/PDF may be preview evidence only; it cannot become the canonical final native PowerPoint exporter.
